description: This source file defines data structures and logic related to displaying gateway usage data. It includes multiple Codable structs representing usage windows, providers, and summaries, as well as a UsageRow struct that formats usage information for UI presentation. Additionally, it contains an asynchronous loader enum to fetch usage summaries.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and decodes the gateway usage summary from a network control channel.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Generates a list of UsageRow objects representing the maximum usage windows per provider.

methods.name: detailText
methods.description: Returns a formatted string describing the remaining usage percentage, window label, and reset time.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Formats the remaining time until reset into a human-readable string.
